text: 硬科技企业正在密集叩开资本市场的大门。昨日（9月3日）晚间，燧原科技打新结果出炉，距离A股上市再进一步。前期，与其同为“国产GPU四小龙”的摩尔线程、沐曦股份均在去年底登陆科创板，壁仞科技年初登陆港交所。 面对硬科技浪潮，投资机构如何抓住机遇？又应如何调整布局？“硬科技不是短期的投资风口。”中科创星创始合伙人米磊表示。 “今年我们投原子制造，前几年投过可控核聚变、二维材料与具身智能等，这些都是一些前沿的方向。”米磊在近期举办的好望角科学沙龙《硬科技浪潮》专场上称。 对于硬科技投资，他进一步谈到，资本的核心是投得准、融得易、不浪费。“让资本真正沉下心来，扎
text_en: Hard-tech companies are intensively knocking on the doors of the capital market. Last night (September 3), the IPO lottery result for Enflame Technology was announced, bringing it a step closer to listing on the A-share market. Earlier, Moore Threads and MetaX, also among the ‘Four Domestic GPU Dragons,’ listed on the STAR Market at the end of last year, while Biren Technology listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at the start of the year. Facing the hard-tech wave, how can investment institutions seize opportunities and adjust their layouts? “Hard tech is not a short-term investment trend,” said Mi Lei, founding partner of CASSTAR. “This year we are investing in atomic manufacturing; in previous years, we invested in controlled nuclear fusion, 2D materials, and embodied intelligence — these are all frontier directions,” Mi Lei stated at the recent Cape of Good Hope Science Salon session on the Hard-Tech Wave. Further discussing hard-tech investment, he noted that the core of capital is to invest accurately, finance easily, and avoid waste. “Let capital truly settle down, and dig deep.”
